summary: RBS Official V2.5 “Institutional DeFi Hub” is a React + TypeScript single-page website backed by an Internet Computer (ICP) Motoko canister. The frontend delivers a themed, content-heavy marketing/site experience (Home, About, Tokenomics, Roadmap, Whitepaper, FAQ, Insights, Testimonials, Security, Ecosystem, etc.), plus interactive utilities: an authenticated Acquisition Portal for presale/airdrop registrations stored in the canister, and a passcode-gated Market Intel dashboard that fetches real-time crypto/forex data from external APIs (CoinGecko + exchangerate.host) and computes trading indicators/signals (standard + binary). Internet Identity is used for authentication; the backend enforces role-based access control and per-principal Market Intel access grants.

existing_features.title: Internet Identity authentication provider
existing_features.description: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider context that initializes DFINITY AuthClient, loads any stored delegation identity, supports login/logout, and exposes detailed status flags (initializing/logging-in/success/error) for UI control.

existing_features.title: ICP canister actor creation per identity with access-control initialization
existing_features.description: Creates an anonymous or authenticated backend actor depending on Internet Identity state, and for authenticated users calls the backend authorization bootstrap method using a secret extracted from the URL hash/session.

existing_features.title: Backend role-based access control (admin/user/guest) with admin bootstrap token
existing_features.description: Implements AccessControl with roles (#admin/#user/#guest), admin-only role assignment, and a bootstrap flow where the first valid initializer can become admin (based on an env token plus a user-provided token); others default to user.

existing_features.title: Market Intel access gating (grant/revoke/check) by passcode
existing_features.description: Backend stores per-principal Market Intel access grants; authenticated users can grant or revoke access by providing the configured passcode, and can query whether they currently have access.

existing_features.title: React Query hooks for backend mutations and queries
existing_features.description: Provides typed hooks for form submission, admin submission listing/filtering/count, Market Intel access grant/revoke/check, and Market Intel/Binary signal fetching with query-key based caching and invalidation.

existing_features.title: Acquisition Portal (presale/airdrop) registration submission
existing_features.description: Frontend AcquisitionPage collects registration data, validates inputs, submits to actor.submitForm, and redirects users to WhatsApp with a prefilled confirmation message upon success.

existing_features.title: Backend storage and management of form submissions
existing_features.description: Stores FormSubmission records keyed by id and includes APIs to create, read with access control (own/admin), update/delete (own/admin), admin list/filter (by type/country), and admin submission counts and mass-delete.

existing_features.title: Presale/airdrop timer queries and admin timer management
existing_features.description: Exposes public queries for remaining time to presale/airdrop endpoints, plus admin-only APIs to toggle, update, and reset timer states stored in a timers map.

existing_features.title: Real-time market data fetching (crypto + forex) with timeouts and retry/backoff
existing_features.description: Client-side fetches crypto data via CoinGecko and forex rates via exchangerate.host using AbortController timeouts, retry loops with exponential backoff, and React Query auto-refresh intervals.

existing_features.title: Technical indicator generation and weighted overall signal computation
existing_features.description: Generates RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, VWAP, Moving Average, Fair Value Gap (FVG), and Order Blocks signals; computes an overall weighted signal and a derived historical accuracy score.

existing_features.title: Binary trading signal generation (WIN/LOSS) with probability and confidence
existing_features.description: Computes a binary prediction (WIN/LOSS) with confidence and winProbability, influenced by market trend and volatility (when available) plus seeded randomness.

existing_features.title: Market Intel dashboard UI with unlock/lock flow and cache clearing
existing_features.description: Implements a passcode unlock flow and a passcode-confirmed lock dialog; when locking it clears selected asset/timeframe state and removes cached React Query results for Market Intel and binary signals.

existing_features.title: AI Sentiment section with simulated live updates
existing_features.description: MarketIntelPage includes an AI Sentiment Analysis section with simulated overall sentiment, score, news impact, and per-platform social metrics that update on an interval.

existing_features.title: Market Pulse page (simulated real-time narrative, sentiment pulse, macro events, live feed)
existing_features.description: Provides a presentation-style market dashboard with auto-updating sentiment/narrative cards, macro event cards, and a live data feed, using smoky transitions and parallax for motion design.

existing_features.title: Alerts Center UI (local alert CRUD + status toggling)
existing_features.description: Provides a client-side alerts management page allowing users to create, toggle (active/paused), and delete alerts with dialogs, badges, and toast feedback (no backend persistence).

existing_features.title: Whitepaper page with chapter navigation and scroll-based active tracking
existing_features.description: Renders a multi-chapter whitepaper with a sticky sidebar; uses IntersectionObserver to track visible sections and update the active chapter, and supports smooth scrolling to chapters.

existing_features.title: Tokenomics visualization with interactive distribution pie chart
existing_features.description: Displays fixed supply and allocation breakdown using a Recharts PieChart with hover highlighting, tooltips/legend, and explanatory sections for deflationary mechanics and utility.

existing_features.title: FAQ page with collapsible Q&A items
existing_features.description: Implements an interactive FAQ list using collapsible components with open/close state and styled content cards.

existing_features.title: Contact page with mailto-based messaging and channel links
existing_features.description: Validates a contact form and opens the user’s email client via mailto; also provides Telegram/WhatsApp links and toast feedback for user actions.

existing_features.title: Site-wide layout, navigation, theme, and notifications
existing_features.description: Provides shared layout with next-themes ThemeProvider, footer, horizontally scrollable bottom navigation (TanStack Router navigation), and a global toaster notification system.

existing_features.title: Unified visual design system with motion utilities
existing_features.description: Defines a gold-accented, high-contrast theme with extensive Tailwind/CSS utilities and animations, including SmokySectionTransition reveal effects and parallax hooks that respect reduced-motion preferences.

existing_features.title: Backend public content record stores with admin CRUD
existing_features.description: Implements multiple content stores (testimonials, insights, FAQ, governance, ecosystem, whitepaper, roadmap, about, community, security, contact) with admin-only create/update/delete/mass-populate/clear and public read access via getRecords.

existing_features.title: Backend blob-storage maintenance endpoints (Caffeine storage mixin)
existing_features.description: Includes endpoints to refresh authorized gateway principals from a cashier canister, list dead blobs to prune, confirm deletions, trigger GC, and refill/top-up cycles via the cashier principal.

existing_features.title: Backend HTTP outcall helper (GET/POST) with transform function
existing_features.description: Provides reusable HTTP GET/POST functions with cycle budgeting, default headers (User-Agent, Idempotency-Key for POST), and a transform that strips response headers.

existing_features.title: Canister upgrade migration hook
existing_features.description: Uses a migration module to map old actor state to new actor state during upgrades, including removal of deprecated fields and preservation of key maps and counters.

architectural_notes: Frontend is a SPA built with TanStack Router for routing and TanStack React Query for server-state caching/invalidation; UI uses TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui and toast notifications via sonner.
Authentication is encapsulated in an InternetIdentityProvider (DFINITY AuthClient) and consumed by a useActor hook that creates an authenticated/anonymous canister actor per identity.
Backend is a Motoko canister composed via mixins (authorization + blob-storage) and uses mo:core Map-based in-memory stores for submissions, access grants, and content records.
Role-based access control (admin/user/guest) is implemented in a custom AccessControl module; initial admin bootstrap depends on an environment token plus a user-provided secret.
Market Intel computations (market data fetch + indicators/signals) are performed client-side; the canister mainly gates access and optionally stores admin-created MarketIntelligence records.
Frontend motion system uses IntersectionObserver-powered section reveals (SmokySectionTransition) and parallax hooks (scroll + pointer) that respect prefers-reduced-motion.
The canister is configured with a migration hook (with migration = Migration.run) to reshape persisted state across upgrades.

Backend includes an ICP HTTP outcall helper with a transform function (strips headers) and fixed cycle budgeting, plus a Caffeine blob-storage maintenance interface (dead-blob pruning, gateway principal refresh, cashier top-up).
known_issues: Nested React Query providers: frontend/src/main.tsx and frontend/src/App.tsx both create QueryClientProvider instances, leading to duplicated caches/clients and potentially confusing behavior.

Market Intel page currently returns a full-screen “Restricted Access” view when locked, so the “AI Sentiment always accessible” content is not actually visible unless unlocked (despite UI copy suggesting otherwise).

Market Intel access grants are stored per principal and persist until explicitly revoked; returning users may remain unlocked without re-entering the passcode, depending on desired security semantics.
Real-time market fetching relies on unauthenticated public APIs; CoinGecko/exchangerate.host may rate-limit or fail, impacting Market Intel reliability.
Forex 24h change/volume are simulated with randomness (not real market data), which can mislead users and makes results non-verifiable.
Indicator/signal generation intentionally mixes seeded randomness and Date.now-based seeding, producing non-deterministic outputs across refreshes.
AccessControl.getUserRole traps for non-anonymous principals that have not called initialization; callers bypassing the initialization flow can hit “User is not registered” traps.
Some React Query hooks (e.g., admin submissions queries) may execute with an anonymous actor and receive backend traps/Unauthorized errors if used without proper gating in UI.

Backend contains sensitive secrets/config in code/flow: marketIntelPassword is hard-coded in the canister; admin bootstrap secret is read from URL hash/session (even though it is cleared from the address bar).
Blob-storage config env var appears typo-prone: CAFFFEINE_STORAGE_CASHIER_PRINCIPAL (triple “F”); misconfiguration will trap at runtime.
